description:
Where your money actually goes — explained with the government's own data.
Why is car insurance so expensive? Do no income tax states really save you money? Why does your electric bill keep rising? The America File answers the questions behind America's biggest costs — cost of living, taxes, insurance, rent and the real cost of owning a car — using official data from the Census Bureau, the Bureau of Labor Statistics and the Energy Information Administration.
Every number is sourced. Every source is listed in the video description. No hype, no conspiracy theories, no financial advice — just the data, explained clearly.
New video every week:
• Cost of living by state, and the cheapest states to live in
• Why your electric bill keeps rising
• Car insurance, and why rates keep climbing
• Where does my tax money go — and how no income tax states actually work
• The real cost of owning a car
The America File. America explained — with the data explained.
